transcript: Most people try to heal their past while still living inside the past. But listen, you don't heal by fighting the old memory. You heal by creating a new experience inside your body. This is how you do it. Step 1. Acknowledge. Don't resist. When the painful memory rises, don't push it away. Take one breath and say to yourself, I see you, but you're not who I am anymore. Step 2. Bring the body back to safety. Close your eyes. Place your hand on your heart and breathe slowly. Four seconds in, six seconds out, until the body remembers peace again. Step 3. Rewrite the program. Take a pen and paper. Write these four things. Which thoughts do I no longer choose? Which feelings do I no longer want to carry? How do I want to feel today? Who do I choose to become in my future? Because when you define the future clearly, the past begins to lose its power. Step 4. The shift. Each time the old emotion returns, pause, breathe, and imagine that feeling leaving your body like a small cloud. Not yours anymore, just energy passing through. This is how healing works. You stop rehearsing the emotions of the past, and you start practicing the emotions of your future. When you do this long enough, your brain rewires, your nervous system calms, and slowly the wound begins to close. Healing does not happen in one day, but every day you choose peace. You take your power back.
